Best for

  • Banquet halls, showrooms, restaurants and large floors
  • Hotels, hospitals and offices that need cooling through ducts
  • Projects where one system should cool several connected areas

How to choose

  • Ductable ACs need a ducting layout, so they are best planned with the building or interior design.
  • Twin-circuit and multi-compressor models keep part of the cooling running if one circuit needs service.
  • Choose R410A models for the newer, ozone-friendly refrigerant; R22 models are also available.
  • Heat-load sizing matters at this scale: we calculate it from the area, occupancy, glass and use.

What capacities do Hitachi ductable ACs come in?

The Toushi and Takumi ranges at Yamini Enterprises cover 3, 4, 5, 5.5, 7.5, 8.5, 11 and 16.5 ton, including single-circuit, twin-circuit, ceiling-suspended and convertible models.

Are Hitachi ductable ACs suitable for Rajasthan's heat?

Yes. Most Toushi and Takumi models are listed with a high ambient design that works up to 52°C outdoors.

Do you take on projects outside Jodhpur?

Yes. We handle HVAC projects across Rajasthan, from design and supply to installation, commissioning and AMC.
